_comment: STUB: what the hosted Worker's operator seed writes into a tenant's database until per-tenant onboarding replaces it (docs/hosted-tenants.md). `settings` is laid over src/cyris/settings_starting_values.json, and the provider and model are fixed to Anthropic's claude-haiku-5-5. It names no digest hours: the seed gives each tenant one hour of its own in `general.timezone`, spread by its id (hosted_seed.js `seedSchedule`, ADR-0042), or the registry's schedule when the tenant has one. `sources` names entries of src/cyris/onboarding_feeds.json for each tenant the runbook registers and seeds; scripts/hosted.sh takes its tenant list from these keys, and the seed route seeds only a tenant the registry holds. No two tenants share a source, so scripts/hosted_check.py can tell their articles apart. tests/test_hosted_config.py holds every setting valid, every required key present and every name in the catalog.
